solution.title: Panama Canal Project Hub

Document library with versioning — Centralized repository with controlled access and full audit trail.
Stakeholder update feed + approvals — Structured communication and approval workflows to accelerate decisions.

solution.title: AAvance NGO Disbursement
solution.summary: Secure and compliant fund distribution platform tailored with Visa Alias Directory for NGOs targeting vulnerable and unbanked populations.
features: Anti De-Duplication of beneficiaries feature.
Single Beneficiary ID across all program rails.
Seamless onboarding for beneficiaries without traditional bank accounts.
Multi-rail disbursement: mobile wallets, cash pick-up, prepaid cards.
solution.useCase: Provide NGOs with a turnkey, traceable way to distribute financial aid to remote or displaced populations efficiently.

solution.title: LAC Government Disbursement
solution.summary: A provider-agnostic orchestration layer that enables compliant, low-cost government disbursements across banks, wallets, and cash networks in high-informality markets.
features: Vendor-agnostic payout adapters (banks, wallets, cash networks)
Risk-based KYC / step-up verification for informal populations
Beneficiary identity resolution — duplicate & fraud prevention
PII minimization + tokenized identity architecture
solution.useCase: Enable ministries and development banks to distribute subsidies, social benefits, and emergency funds at scale — with flexibility to switch payout providers.

Anti de-duplication & fraud prevention via beneficiary resolution
Multi-rail disbursement (banks, wallets, cash correspondents)

solution.title: @visa-gov/sdk
solution.summary: Government procurement is slow, opaque, and expensive. @visa-gov/sdk wires the full Visa B2B payment infrastructure into a single TypeScript package — letting agencies go from discovering a supplier to settling a payment in one coherent flow.
features: SDK — TypeScript-native package exposing the complete Visa B2B API surface: supplier discovery, payment controls, and settlement.
MCP Server — AI Agents, Zero Code — Model Context Protocol server lets AI agents drive end-to-end procurement workflows.
AI-powered supplier scoring with real-time payment controls at every step.
solution.useCase: Fast adoption for Fintech companies and Visa providers looking to integrate government B2B procurement and payment flows into their platforms.

solution.title: Student Beca CR
solution.summary: A Costa Rican citizen seeking financial aid can access government-funded scholarships disbursed instantly through a Visa card — removing friction between approval and access to funds.
features: Instant card issuance — Scholarship recipients receive a Visa card the moment their eligibility is approved.
Government-funded disbursement — Public scholarship funds flow directly to the student's Visa card in real time.
Digital-first onboarding — Students complete identity verification fully online.
solution.useCase: Enable Costa Rican students approved for government scholarships to instantly receive and spend their academic funding via a Visa card — whether studying domestically or abroad.

solution.title: IMAS CR — Avancemos
solution.summary: Costa Rica's Avancemos conditional cash transfer program — delivering monthly stipends to 325,000+ students via a Visa prepaid card, with digital enrollment, biometric KYC, and instant disbursement through IMAS × BNCR.
features: Conditional cash transfer via Visa prepaid card — ₡55,000/month to eligible households, no bank account required.
SINIRUBE/MEP real-time verification — eligibility checked live against government databases at enrollment.
Digital-first onboarding with biometric KYC — liveness check and document upload, fully online across 82 cantons.
Instant disbursement via Visa Direct — funds arrive the moment eligibility is confirmed.
solution.useCase: Enable IMAS and BNCR to deliver Avancemos conditional cash transfers to 325,000+ students across Costa Rica through a Visa prepaid card — reducing fraud, eliminating cash dependency, and ensuring funds reach beneficiaries in real time.

solution.title: MTT Panama
solution.summary: A modern turnkey platform for Panama's mass transit ecosystem — enabling seamless fare management, multi-modal card integration, and real-time operational visibility for transit authorities and riders.
features: Multi-modal transit card management — Unified credential across bus, metro, and ferry with real-time balance and top-up.
Fare engine & rule configuration — Configurable pricing rules, transfer discounts, time-based fare policies.
Open-loop acceptance — Contactless bank card and mobile wallet acceptance alongside closed-loop transit credentials.
solution.useCase: Equip Panama's transit authority with a unified, card-based fare platform that reduces cash dependency, accelerates boarding, and gives operators real-time visibility.

solution.title: Macro Disbursement

features: High-volume batch disbursements across banks, wallets, and cash networks.
Beneficiary identity resolution with fraud prevention and de-duplication.
Real-time transaction monitoring and program-level reconciliation.

solution.title: Visa Gov Disbursement Boilerplate
solution.summary: A production-ready boilerplate for building government disbursement applications on Visa infrastructure — pre-wired with multi-rail payout adapters, beneficiary identity resolution, and compliance controls so teams can ship faster.

Beneficiary identity resolution — deduplication and fraud prevention built in.
Compliance-first architecture — KYC/KYB hooks, audit trail, and PII minimization patterns.
Configurable program rules — disbursement caps, eligibility gates, and reconciliation workflows.
